title: Fold DisjointUnionSets into UnionFind, and the knot union forest stops being a static global on Knot
description:
After MESH-63, geometry/tsp/cuts/DisjointUnionSets is a thin wrapper over numeric.graph.UnionFind: find(Knot) already calls UnionFind.find(parent, k.id). What it adds is not knot-specific: Knot-keyed find/union that only unwrap k.id, growable parent/rank arrays (addSet), union by rank (the lower-ranked root moves under the higher; on a tie the second knot's root goes under the first's), and a running count of addSet calls (totalNumGroups). The rank rule matters: the surviving root is the group id the cut-match search uses, which is why MESH-63 kept it out of UnionFind.union (whose ~10 other callers also observe the root).

Add a rank variant to UnionFind (e.g. unionByRank(parent, rank, first, second) with the same tie rule) plus growth (a helper, or the caller sizes the arrays); the TSP code (Knot, KnotEngine) calls UnionFind with knot ids and keeps its own parent, rank and group count; delete DisjointUnionSets. Every other UnionFind caller keeps today's behaviour.

Also: the forest is a static global, Knot.unionSet, shared by every knot. Make it state of the engine that runs the search (KnotEngine), not a static on Knot.
definition-of-done:
1. DisjointUnionSets is gone; the TSP search uses UnionFind's rank variant keyed by knot id, with the same tie rule.
2. Knot.unionSet is gone; the union forest is state of the search engine.
3. Other UnionFind callers are unchanged.
4. The knot editor solves every .ix fixture to the same knots and tour as before (before/after recording); mvn test passes.
testing-plan:
1. Before any change, record the solved knots and tour length for the knot editor's .ix fixtures (ixdar-canvas, ask/ls output and ui-state knotEditor); compare after.
2. mvn test.
changes-made: UnionFind gains unionByRank (lower rank moves under higher; on a tie the second's root goes under the first's) and grow (covers an element, at least doubling, new entries singletons); UnionFindTest covers both. DisjointUnionSets and the static Knot.unionSet are deleted: the forest is KnotEngine.groupParent/groupRank (per shell's engine), filled by KnotEngine.addGroup, and Knot/KnotEngine call UnionFind with knot ids. findKnots sizes its per-group buffers by the forest length instead of a cumulative add count. Other UnionFind callers untouched. Verification: with the forest temporarily made static again the knot editor reproduces the baseline byte-for-byte on 8 .ix fixtures; with the per-engine forest the first-loaded file (djbouti) and 3 others are identical, while clover, box_bottleneck, djbouti_14-31 and circle_in_100 solve differently when loaded after another file, because the old static kept the previous solve's ranks; the new results are independent of load order. mvn test: 609 run, 0 failed.
review-summary: The knot search's union-find forest moves from a static DisjointUnionSets on Knot into KnotEngine, using a new rank-merging union in UnionFind. A static forest shared by every shell let one solve's leftover ranks change the knots a later file solved to, and duplicated UnionFind.
